$comment: Dependency license policy for scripts/check-licenses.mjs (open-source preparation, stage ק4). 'allowed': licenses any production dependency may use. 'denied': patterns that always fail (source-available terms, or copyleft incompatible with the AGPL-3.0) — unless the package is listed in 'exceptions'. 'allowed' is checked first, so BSL-1.0 (Boost, permissive) passes while BSL/BUSL (Business Source) fail. Anything neither allowed nor denied is 'unknown' and fails too. An exception is per package name + exact license string, with a reason; a new version under the same license stays allowed, a license change fails again.

exceptions.reason: Sentry's CLI. It is only reachable through @sentry/node -> @sentry/bundler-plugins (core/cli.js, source-map upload at build time), which is loaded only from @sentry/node's ./vite|./rollup|./webpack|./esbuild subpath exports. The platform imports none of them (only the main @sentry/node and @sentry/react entries), so this package is installed but never loaded at runtime, and we build no product that competes with Sentry (the only FSL restriction). It becomes Apache-2.0 two years after each release.

bundled.name: Rubik Regular (font)
bundled.use: The Regular (wght 400) instance of Rubik[wght].ttf from github.com/google/fonts (ofl/rubik), made with fontTools varLib.instancer; embedded (subset) in interactive-document PDFs (apps/api/src/modules/idocs/idocs.pdf.ts).
